sources.name:
YouTube: NVIDIA Developer** | unknown | 209 words | [Watch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JIeLDmAG8y0)

How can one AI platform support specialized AI across industries? In Episode 5 of AI Factory Insider, NVIDIA's livestream series for IT leaders and practitioners, host Kaushik Shirhatti (VP, AI Factory, NVIDIA) is joined by Pradeep Gupta (VP, Industries Solutions Architecture, NVIDIA) to unpack what “vertically integrated, horizontally open” means in practice. We’ll start with the fundamentals of CUDA libraries: what they are, how developers use them, and why they matter. Then we’ll explore how NVIDIA architectures, libraries, software, and open-source tools provide a common foundation for distinct AI workloads across financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, and beyond. To close, we’ll look ahead at how CUDA-powered capabilities are evolving for AI agents and what that means for enterprise workflows. What you'll learn: - What “vertically integrated, horizontally open” means — understand how an optimized full-stack platform can support a broad ecosystem of industries, applications, and tools. - How the platform fits together — connect NVIDIA architectures, CUDA libraries, software, and open-source tools in clear, practitioner-friendly language. - How CUDA libraries support specialized workloads — examine practical examples from financial services, healthcare, and manufacturing without losing sight of the common platform underneath. Join us live, bring your questions, and learn how a common accelerated-computing foundation can support specialized AI across industries.

updates.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
updates.summary: GPT‑Live‑1 brings natural, full-duplex voice conversations to the API, with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and telephony support.

updates.title: Introducing the Agents API
updates.summary: Build and launch cloud agents with the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness for orchestration, long-running sessions, and tool use.

updates.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
updates.summary: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.

updates.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
updates.summary: Meet GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s most capable model for business, with advanced reasoning, computer use, and stronger writing and design judgment.

updates.title: Paul Christiano joins OpenAI Foundation Board
updates.summary: Paul Christiano joins the OpenAI Foundation Board and its Safety and Security Committee, bringing experience in AI alignment, safety, and standards.

updates.title: Modernizing complex legacy code with AI agents.
updates.summary: Mistral helped a European energy operator migrate 40,000 lines of Fortran 77 to C++. Learn how it was done, and the lessons to carry forward.

updates.title: Get ready for the game with new football features in Search
updates.summary: Track live game feeds, explore detailed stats, and get custom fantasy recommendations directly in Search this season.

updates.title: Recreating a 70-year love story frame by frame
updates.summary: Discover how filmmakers and Google DeepMind used AI to recreate a couple's unrecorded past in the short film "Love, Rendered."

updates.title: Cursor Projects
updates.summary: Projects lets you take on larger bodies of work, maintain context over months, and delegate tasks to thousands of subagents.
